title: TargetDesign-workbench
description:
A toolkit for motif-driven CRISPR guide design: motif patterns are defined first, candidate regions are extracted, exact, indexed, BLAST-based and model-based off-target searches are run, candidates are scored, filtered and ranked, and results are exported through a desktop workbench, a local web UI and command-line tools.

Documentation is provided in the repository under the docs/ directory.
